{{Quote|Your grandfather killed my grand-uncle in a duel! His blood howls for yours!|An unidentified Wookiee to Chewbacca|<ref name="SW:C2" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who emerged as a powerful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] in the last [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He once [[Death/Legends|killed]] another Wookiee in a duel, which provoked a lasting enmity between his clan and that of the deceased opponent.<ref name="SW:C2" />
